about.description:
INPOLY returns the "inside/outside" status for a set of vertices VERT and a general
polygon (PSLG) embedded in the two-dimensional plane. General non-convex and
multiply-connected polygonal regions can be handled.
about.summary: A fast point(s)-in-polygon routine for Python.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: inpoly
  version: "0.2.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/dengwirda/inpoly-python/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a17ff303a24bc9d4a61be421a1cdbf62959edd7487c95a5785d917a0017e334f
  patches:
    - 0001-remove-msh.patch
    - 0002-save-plots.patch

build:
  number: 11
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - python
    - cython
    - pip
    - numpy
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - inpoly
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - msh/*
        - dat/*
        - example.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - matplotlib-base
    script:
      - python example.py --IDnumber 1
      - python example.py --IDnumber 2
      - python example.py --IDnumber 3

about:
  license: LicenseRef-Custom
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: A fast point(s)-in-polygon routine for Python.
  description: |
    INPOLY returns the "inside/outside" status for a set of vertices VERT and a general
    polygon (PSLG) embedded in the two-dimensional plane. General non-convex and
    multiply-connected polygonal regions can be handled.
  homepage: https://github.com/dengwirda/inpoly-python
  repository: https://github.com/dengwirda/inpoly-python
  documentation: https://github.com/dengwirda/inpoly-python/blob/master/README.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
    - dengwirda
